name: wp-category-featured-image-rotator
description: Automatically assigns featured images to posts from category-specific image pools.

scripts.test:php: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-category-featured-image-rotator env WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX=wptests_ vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run check:boundaries && npm run test:php
scripts.test:php:multisite: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-category-featured-image-rotator env WP_MULTISITE=1 WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX=wptests_ vendor/bin/phpunit
